About this item

  • 3-in-1 Universal Power Extender: A 3-pin universal multiplug power extender with individual switches, letting you connect and control multiple devices from a single socket.
  • Integrated Power Switch: Instant one-click ON/OFF control for each socket individually, so you can power devices on or off without pulling the plug: safe, reliable, and energy-saving.
  • 5A High Power Capacity: Built to handle heavy loads such as laptops, routers, tablets, and mobile chargers simultaneously without performance drop.
  • Premium Copper Build: Solid brass pins and copper internals ensure enhanced conductivity, heat resistance, and stable performance over time.
  • Universal Socket Compatibility: Supports multiple socket standards, making it fit for use across different plug types: ideal for home, office, and travel.
  • Red LED Indicator: Each switch has a red LED that lights up to confirm an active power connection, adding a visible safety check.
  • Compact & Easy to Carry: Lightweight, pocket-friendly design that slips easily into a bag, offering power convenience wherever you go.
  • Child Safety Shutters: Built-in safety shutters on all three outlets protect against accidental insertion, making it safe for home use.

      Product description

      The Portronics Swix is a 3-in-1 universal multi-plug adapter designed to simplify how you power multiple devices from a single socket. With three individually switched outlets, you get instant one-click control to turn devices on or off without unplugging: safe, convenient, and energy-efficient. Built with solid brass pins and a premium copper core, it delivers enhanced conductivity and heat resistance, while supporting a high 5A load for laptops, routers, and chargers alike. Universal socket compatibility makes it usable across multiple plug standards, and the red LED indicator on each switch offers a quick visual check of power status. Compact, lightweight, and fitted with child safety shutters, the Swix is built for safe, reliable use at home, in the office, or on the move.

      • vkv
        5 out of 5 stars
        Individual switches per socket, solid copper internals, and fits international plugs snugly
        Reviewed in India on 19 October 2026
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I picked up the Portronics Swix Multi Plug Adapter to expand a single 3-pin wall outlet on my work desk without dealing with messy extension cords, and the dedicated switches, firm socket grip, and build safety have been fantastic.

        Key Highlights:

        Individual Switches with LED Indicators: Each of the 3 outlets has its own independent rocker switch and indicator light, allowing you to turn off a laptop charger or desk lamp without disturbing other plugged-in devices.

        Firm 3-Pin Universal Sockets: The brass/copper internal terminals grip Indian, US, and EU plug pins firmly, preventing heavy power bricks from sagging or sparking.

        Integrated Child Safety Shutters: Built-in internal safety shutters prevent accidental foreign object insertion, giving peace of mind around curious toddlers and pets.

        5A/6A High-Power Rating: Easily handles multiple everyday peripherals simultaneously, including phone chargers, monitor supplies, Wi-Fi routers, and desk fans.

        Compact Wall-Mounted Footprint: Plugs directly into the wall socket without dangling or occupying floor space, keeping desk cables neat and organized.

        Tip: While it accommodates three devices comfortably, note that it is rated for standard 5A/6A loads (up to ~1000–1200W total)—ideal for consumer electronics, chargers, and IT gadgets, but not intended for heavy heating appliances like geysers or microwave ovens.

        Verdict:

        A dependable, well-engineered multi-plug adapter that adds switchable convenience and clean power organization to any room. Highly recommended!

      About this Item

      • 3-in-1 Universal Power Extender: A 3-pin universal multiplug power extender with individual switches, letting you connect and control multiple devices from a single socket.
      • Integrated Power Switch: Instant one-click ON/OFF control for each socket individually, so you can power devices on or off without pulling the plug: safe, reliable, and energy-saving.
      • 5A High Power Capacity: Built to handle heavy loads such as laptops, routers, tablets, and mobile chargers simultaneously without performance drop.
      • Premium Copper Build: Solid brass pins and copper internals ensure enhanced conductivity, heat resistance, and stable performance over time.
      • Universal Socket Compatibility: Supports multiple socket standards, making it fit for use across different plug types: ideal for home, office, and travel.
      • Red LED Indicator: Each switch has a red LED that lights up to confirm an active power connection, adding a visible safety check.
      • Compact & Easy to Carry: Lightweight, pocket-friendly design that slips easily into a bag, offering power convenience wherever you go.
      • Child Safety Shutters: Built-in safety shutters on all three outlets protect against accidental insertion, making it safe for home use.

      Product description

      The Portronics Swix is a 3-in-1 universal multi-plug adapter designed to simplify how you power multiple devices from a single socket. With three individually switched outlets, you get instant one-click control to turn devices on or off without unplugging: safe, convenient, and energy-efficient. Built with solid brass pins and a premium copper core, it delivers enhanced conductivity and heat resistance, while supporting a high 5A load for laptops, routers, and chargers alike. Universal socket compatibility makes it usable across multiple plug standards, and the red LED indicator on each switch offers a quick visual check of power status. Compact, lightweight, and fitted with child safety shutters, the Swix is built for safe, reliable use at home, in the office, or on the move.
